title: Paul McCartney live: Pepsi Center, Denver | 2005
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Pepsi Center in Denver, Colorado, USA, on 1 November 2005.

It was the 23rd show of the US Tour, which lasted for 37 dates between September and November 2005. This show was seen by 15,091 fans.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

McCartney had previously performed at the Pepsi Center during the Driving World Tour on 7 May 2002. He returned there on 15 July 2010 for the Up And Coming Tour.
